recognize_zh: 骨小樑之間的骨髓被腫瘤取代，可見成群的大型細胞具豐富嗜雙色細胞質、偏心泡狀核與明顯核仁，部分為雙核，外觀似神經節細胞，背景為淡粉紅纖維狀基質，符合伴有神經節分化的轉移性神經母細胞瘤。
features: Marrow space between trabeculae replaced by a tumor infiltrate within a pale fibrillary (neuropil-like/schwannian) stroma
Clusters of large ganglion-like cells with abundant amphophilic to eosinophilic cytoplasm
Eccentric round vesicular nuclei with prominent single nucleoli; occasional binucleate cells
Intermixed smaller cells with hyperchromatic nuclei and spindle stromal cells
Absence of normal hematopoiesis in the involved area; interstitial hemorrhage and bony trabeculae at edges
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows intertrabecular replacement by a tumor composed of clusters of large ganglion-like cells with abundant amphophilic cytoplasm, eccentric vesicular nuclei and prominent nucleoli, some binucleate, set in a pale fibrillary stroma with admixed smaller hyperchromatic cells. Normal hematopoietic elements are not seen in the involved area. Findings are consistent with metastatic neuroblastic tumor with ganglionic differentiation (differentiating neuroblastoma or ganglioneuroblastoma), to be confirmed by PHOX2B, PGP9.5 and synaptophysin immunostains with correlation to urine catecholamines and imaging.

ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive glands or nests in desmoplastic stroma and are cytokeratin positive, lacking neuropil and PHOX2B expression.
Megakaryocytes have multilobated nuclei without prominent single nucleoli and are scattered among hematopoietic cells rather than clustered in fibrillary stroma.
Rhabdomyoblasts have eccentric nuclei and eosinophilic cytoplasm too, but express desmin and myogenin rather than neural markers.

ddx.dx: Osteoblasts / osteoclasts in a remodeling marrow
ddx.vs: Osteoblasts line trabecular surfaces with a perinuclear hof and osteoclasts are multinucleated, not forming clusters within neuropil-like stroma.
